recipes.label: In Exchange for Value
recipes.startdescription: These will suffice. I shall obtain what I need.

recipes.label: Clarified with Reason
recipes.startdescription: Once gains and losses are clearly weighed, reason can take the lead.
recipes.description: It is done. I have secured support.

recipes.label: With Passionate Oratory
recipes.startdescription: Passion can sway the gullible—even when the speech lacks solid grounds.
recipes.description: It is done. I have won their support.

recipes.label: Salvage Usable Supplies
recipes.startdescription:
The target location may hold quite valuable materials, but I must exert effort to navigate the chaos along the way.

[Meet the threshold to achieve the objective.]

recipes.label: Salvage Usable Supplies
recipes.startdescription:
A modicum of effort is enough to resolve the trivial troubles along the road.

[This will take some time and randomly grant you useful resources, though there is a small chance of leaving traces.]
recipes.description: These will prove handy on the journey ahead.。

recipes.label: Confiscating Supplies from Local Farms
recipes.startdescription: Hunger can drive people to madness—but the gap in power, along with the fear of authority and the flames of war, can overwhelm it.
recipes.description: Thus, they obediently hand over their surplus supplies and tighten their belts in preparation for the days ahead.

recipes.label: Hunt the Long: Garrisons of Triple Knot
recipes.startdescription:
Hunting down this exposed Long will thwart the hostile faction. I can carry little with me—this strike must be swift and lethal.

[You must pass two challenges—one random, one fixed—to damage this hostile faction.]

recipes.label: Destroy Base Camp: Garrisons of Triple Knot
recipes.startdescription:
Destroying this exposed base camp will cripple this hostile group. I can carry little with me—this strike must be swift and lethal.

[You must pass two challenges—one random, one fixed—to reduce the threat of the hostile group.]

recipes.comments: 根据进度数量抽取不同的阻碍。
抽取特殊阻碍：the Malachite之拥
这一配方链接着所有对抗敌对团体时可能出现的阻碍。

recipes.label: Advancing the Action
recipes.startdescription: Now that I have overcome this obstacle, I can continue to draw nearer to my goal—

recipes.label: Overwhelming Power
recipes.startdescription:
Even without proper preparation, sheer overwhelming force still grants me the chance to disregard their resistance—

[Thanks to the disparity in strength, you always have a small probability to bypass challenge conditions when confronting hostile groups.]

recipes.label: Unsuccessful Action!
recipes.startdescription: Their hasty resistance couldn't harm me, but it bought them enough time to relocate. The strength of this hostile group remains undiminished.

recipes.label: Challenge: Cover of the Horned‑Axe
recipes.startdescription:
My target seeks to invoke the Horned‑Axe to obstruct my progress—

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Force
recipes.startdescription: Brutal force tears straight through the Horned‑Axe's defenses. I remain unhindered.

recipes.label: Respond with Opening
recipes.startdescription: Serpents are the visitors which may not be denied.

recipes.label: Challenge: Fade into Shadows
recipes.startdescription:
My target is attempting to conceal their trail and flee—

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Illumination
recipes.startdescription: But under the light, they have nowhere to hide.

recipes.label: Respond with Patience
recipes.startdescription: A little extra calm and patience is enough to deal with their tricks.

recipes.label: Challenge: The red's Misdirection
recipes.startdescription:
My target is attempting to distract me with the temptations of the Red Grail—

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Torment
recipes.startdescription: Understanding the nature of the Red Grail allows me to counter temptation with torment, thus I am not obstructed.

recipes.label: Respond with Yearning
recipes.startdescription: Even the Red Grail is deeply troubled by the buzzing in the skull—I can exploit the contradictions within its power to break free from temptation.。

recipes.label: Challenge: The Curse of Verdancy
recipes.startdescription:
My target is attempting to drive me back with their patron’s curse—

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: Unceasing agitation is enough to completely shut out feeble curses.

recipes.label: Respond with Torment
recipes.startdescription: I brim with red vitality—an attack of this level is far from enough to harm me.

recipes.label: Challenge: Sealed Incantation
recipes.startdescription:
My target is attempting to block me with a sealing incantation—

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Flame
recipes.startdescription: Closed things may be shaped, altered, and then opened.

recipes.label: Respond with Opening
recipes.startdescription: Serpents are the visitors which may not be denied.

recipes.label: Challenge: Embrace of the Malachite
recipes.startdescription:
I must break the protective power of the Malachite in a single strike and kill my target—

[Meet any threshold, or provide a Molten weapon to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Blade of Transformation
recipes.startdescription: The flame arrives before the blade—the former changes, the latter destroys.

recipes.label: Searing Blade
recipes.startdescription: Before the mysteries of change and conquest, their defenses are feeble and brittle.

recipes.label: Challenge: Kill a Long
recipes.startdescription:
It is no harder than killing a mortal.

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Force
recipes.startdescription: Utterly destroy them with overwhelming might.

recipes.label: Respond with Finality
recipes.startdescription: The art of ending shall extinguish this person's flame of life.

recipes.label: Challenge: Destroy Base Camp
recipes.startdescription:
I must create some chaos to accomplish this.

[Meet any threshold to pass the challenge.]

recipes.label: Respond with Flame
recipes.startdescription: Then, let the flames take over everything.

recipes.label: Respond with Chaos
recipes.startdescription: Smoke and shadows—chaos is the accomplice of destruction.

recipes.comments: 过渡配方，转化机会并使资源疲劳

recipes.label: Hunt the Long: Succeed!
recipes.description: The force of this hostile group has been dealt a blow.

recipes.label: Destroy Base Camp: Succeed
recipes.description: The power of this hostile group has been significantly reduced.
